summary: Mapped verification support aggregation and success consumption. Runner logs establish local response association, but not stale support or public API failure. Selected a question requiring actual reply production before registration and a correlated completion endpoint.

old.system_boundary: The repository Go raft package, including replication and lease consumers plus built-in storage and transport variants. Application FSM and deployment adapter selection remain caller responsibilities; built-in implementations are inside the available audit boundary.
protocol_contexts: Raft current term and per-follower replication currentTerm
Peer ServerID/address and latest configuration voter membership
ownership: replicate launches a separate heartbeat goroutine for a followerReplication object
checkLeaderLease is owned by the main Raft thread
NewRaft restores current term and last log through injected stores
selection_injection: NewRaft receives all five interfaces from its caller; no deployed adapter choice is supplied.
NetworkTransport selects an injected stream and timeout; InmemTransport has its own queue and timeout.
variants: Ordinary AppendEntries and pipelined AppendEntries response processing
Pre-vote disabled by configuration or missing WithPreVote transport capability
Built-in InmemStore, InmemSnapshotStore and FileSnapshotStore constructors; their failure semantics remain unexpanded
NetworkTransport and InmemTransport; the latter does not support heartbeat fast-path registration
unknowns: Concrete deployed configuration, adapters and FSM are unspecified.
Startup, storage failure semantics, snapshot publication and network fast-path dispatch need deeper reading.
